purpose: Provide opt-in NewYou worktree commands with a live DevCore managed allocation, fail-closed database identity checks, worktree-local execution artifacts, and private mutable Dialyzer core PLTs.

implementation_revision.semantics: WELL-147 corrective source after independent R1-R3 review. Focused guards, actual installed descriptor handoff, cache special-file/replacement recovery and managed migrations plus 35 bootstrap/result tests passed. Initial parallel and diagnostic staggered pilots did not complete; two generations are preserved in quarantine after supervisor loss. New acquisition is disabled, and local admission now requires the separate WELL-154 DevCore 1.2.1 correction, which is not installed. Full application isolation/reuse, heavy measurements, final executor gates, bounded OCR, hosted CI and independent merge review remain unverified.

authoritative_domain: NewYou developer tooling. This capability owns no business Domain or participant behavior.

collaborating_domains.interface: The local entry point checks DevCore version and worktree job status, then delegates profile execution to DevCore. Runtime configuration verifies the active job receipt through the installed DevCore command.
collaborating_domains.ownership: DevCore owns slot leases, generation resources, credentials, job supervision, and cleanup. NewYou owns only its local admission checks, environment binding checks, worktree build lock, and local tool caches.

request_flow.summary: The developer invokes tools/newyou-local with dev or test and a child command. The wrapper checks the repository root, project declaration, supported DevCore version, and unresolved same-worktree jobs under an inheritable build lock. It then execs mise and DevCore run for the selected profile.

Before Repo startup, LocalConfig rejects partial markers, verifies the live managed job receipt, checks the exact slot and generation-derived database and role, validates environment binding, and rejects TEST partitions. Missing or mismatched managed context fails closed when the managed pool is declared. Hosted CI requires both runner flags and uses its separate ephemeral database and role; caller-controlled flags cannot select workstation shared TEST.

Before local Dialyzer analysis, LocalDialyzer derives a cache identity from toolchain versions, Dialyxir source, the core application set, and core beam/application inputs. The cache helper serializes baseline preparation, checks its manifest and file hashes, publishes complete baselines atomically, and copies them to a distinct worktree-local directory before Dialyxir mutates them. The project PLT includes the already pinned Dialyxir API so the build task is analyzed without suppressing unknown-function findings.

Restart-child scripts invoke the existing read-only Proof.Result.capture_postgresql preflight before fixture operations. The production exclusion probe validates inherited TEST configuration while starting no Repo and keeping its private production build worktree-local. The managed-slot probe requires TEST, complete managed markers, a live verified receipt and the generation-specific managed database before fixture or child operations. The two-worktree pilot stopped without passing; acquisition is disabled and both generations remain quarantined.

security_invariants.summary: Managed identity markers alone do not authorize a database target. LocalConfig requires a successful live DevCore receipt and exact field agreement. Verification failure, partial markers, stale allocation, mismatched worktree or database binding raises before Repo startup.

NewYou keeps shared DEV fixed at its legacy endpoint and identity. Managed jobs can select TEST only through the verified generation-specific TEST receipt. Hosted CI uses a separate ephemeral database and role. Caller-controlled CI flags do not authorize workstation shared TEST, and TEST partitioning remains unsupported.
The wrapper does not print captured DevCore status output or inherited credentials. Cache files and lock paths reject symlink substitution and unmanaged destination replacement.

The explicit ci mode is accepted only when both GITHUB_ACTIONS and CI equal true, and selects the dedicated hosted-CI database and role. These flags do not authenticate hosted origin. Workstation shared TEST is rejected whenever the managed pool is declared, even if callers set both flags; partial managed markers also reject. The normal local entry point does not permit the ci override.

concurrency.summary: The command lock is scoped to a Git worktree and inherited by its child process chain. It excludes overlapping build commands in that worktree while permitting work in sibling worktrees. It does not lock TEST globally.

The PLT preparation lock is keyed to one cache identity and covers baseline validation or creation and atomic publication. The helper releases it before copying into a worktree path; Dialyzer analysis runs without holding the shared-cache lock, so separate worktrees use separate mutable PLT copies. Manifest reads require an owned regular file opened without following symlinks; FIFO, directory, socket, symlink and wrong-owner manifests reject without blocking and release the cache lock.

idempotency_retry.summary: A valid complete PLT baseline for the same cache key is reused. A failed producer does not publish an incomplete baseline, so a later attempt can prepare it again. A worktree copy with a matching ownership marker and cache key is reused.

failure_recovery.summary: Unavailable DevCore status, unsupported installation, unresolved same-worktree jobs, malformed project declaration, or unsafe lock state prevents child launch with a bounded non-secret diagnosis.

Invalid or incomplete PLT baseline metadata, digest mismatch, unsafe path, producer failure, or unowned destination prevents Dialyzer analysis. Staging files are removed on failed publication, and the previous owned local copy is restored when atomic replacement fails.

safe_extensions.summary: Keep DevCore receipt semantics and managed resource lifecycle in DevCore. NewYou should validate the returned identity and never duplicate slot allocation, generation advancement, credential provisioning, job supervision, or cleanup.
Add local command conveniences only through the managed entry point and preserve explicit legacy and CI compatibility gates.
Change PLT cache identity when the OTP, Elixir, Dialyxir source, core application set, core runtime inputs, or cache format changes. Continue to give each worktree its own writable PLT copies.

reuse.summary: Use the existing NewYou.Repo and runtime configuration seam for database target selection. No second Repo or business persistence path is introduced.
Use pinned Mix, OTP, Elixir, and Dialyxir tooling and preserve the existing GitHub Actions PLT cache behavior.

prohibited_shortcuts.summary: Do not infer authorization from a database name prefix, local environment markers, or a successful TCP connection without live DevCore receipt verification.
Do not partition the NOCREATEDB TEST role, fall back from managed mode to shared TEST, redirect managed work to DEV, or create NewYou-owned slot databases and roles.
Do not share mutable Dialyxir core PLT files across worktrees, hold the cache lock for full analysis, or serialize the TEST database and full test suite through the PLT lock.

proof_limitations: Managed migrations and 35 bootstrap/result tests passed after correcting two legacy-only identity assertions. Both diagnostic worktrees emitted own-count 1 and peer-count 0 after synthetic registration and browser login, but their receipt/barrier protocol stalled and supervisor ownership was lost. No completed two-worktree child/cross-slot-denial or cleanup/reuse proof is claimed. Guarded recovery quarantined the two exact generations; their databases and records remain preserved. New acquisitions are disabled.

Real cold PLT preparation passed on OTP 29.1.2 / Elixir 1.20.5, first DEV 2:58.40 / 3692448 KiB max RSS; TEST preparation plus analysis 4:25.69 / 3465708 KiB, and peer TEST preparation 4:11.22 / 4087804 KiB. Two subsequent TEST analyses passed with zero errors and 17.385 seconds of overlapping analysis at source e583d5cd22c42b7850711ecf07c15a27702bd85b while the shared cache lock was free. Full-suite capacity remains unmeasured. Latest pure tests: cache 14, admission 11, LocalConfig 19; eight probe guard/adapter tests passed. Earlier compilation and 34 knowledge tests passed; final knowledge checks are refreshed separately.

DEV-profile analysis failed with 20 warnings, then 18 after adding pinned :dialyxir to project PLT inputs. No LocalDialyzer unknown-function warnings remain. TEST-profile static analysis passed with zero errors/skips, so the observed DEV failure does not establish failure in the required TEST compile profile. The unchanged Communications/Privacy sources were not compared in a separate base DEV run; those DEV warnings are not certified as baseline.

Hosted CI uses the separate new_you_ci_test database and role on port 55433. Caller-controlled flags do not authenticate CI, and workstation shared TEST rejects these flags even when both are present. Exact-head hosted CI remains unverified.

WELL-154 corrects canonical renderer contention and a failure-path double-close. Its 1.2.1 source passed temporary contention/parallel/timeout/cancellation tests and the full local DevCore suite, but is not installed or integrated. This worktree rejects installed 1.2.0 before allocation. Prior exact manifest consent is preserved; a new executable installation and any quarantine reconciliation need their own reviewed exact targets.

The regular mix check, final TEST-profile mix check.deep, bounded OCR, exact-head hosted CI, final independent Master Gate, NewYou merge and resulting-main checks remain unverified. This checkpoint is not review-ready.

The persistence locator points to the DevCore slot allocation JSON because this capability has no NewYou migration or table. Its slots/database_prefix fields configure allocation. DevCore owns lease lifecycle and cleanup; this map describes consumer checks only.
